title: fix(cli)!: os validate and os build refuse a flow whose region the automation engine refuses to register
body:
domain:server#5 · os-project-manager · session_01FEkQ5oc56xChD6Wrc4cGSt

<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-project-manager"} -->
_Requested by **Leehom** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1X?thread=cmsg_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1X8dNy8r76WjFsVdvaSJbXXR)_

Fixes #28893

Clause-②: no (narrowing)
Metadata-protocol: none
Skills-docs: none — no file under `skills/**` teaches what `os validate` / `os build` refuse about flow regions; the region rules themselves are unchanged.

## 维护者速读

- 问题：`os validate` 和 `os build` 放行一个 `try_catch` / `loop` / `parallel` 区域不是单入口单出口（或单分支 parallel）的 flow，build 还照常产出 artifact；引擎在 `registerFlow` 里用 `validateControlFlow` 拒绝它，启动只记一条 `[Automation] failed to register flow` 警告，然后不带这个 flow 继续运行，触发器从不触发。
- 现在：两条命令对每个 flow 调用引擎注册时的同一判定（`FlowSchema`，再 spec 导出的 `validateControlFlow`），任意深度；拒绝信息就是引擎原文（`<where>: <errors>`）前面加 flow 名，退出码 1，build 不写 `dist/`。规则没有第二份拷贝，未改 `packages/spec/**`。
- 这是作者期的收窄（`Clause-②: no (narrowing)`，标题带 `!`）：新拒绝的每个 flow 本来就注册失败、从未运行，运行中的 flow 不受影响。
- 未做（已列入 out_of_scope）：`os lint` 仍看不见这个检查（parity 测试里以 `blindTo: ['lint']` 钉住）；顶层图的环（`detectCycles` 在 service-automation 内且未导出）validate 仍放行；启动横幅不计"注册失败"数，只在 Boot diagnostics 里逐条出现。

## What changes

- **`packages/cli/src/utils/flow-region-shape.ts`** (new): `findFlowRegionRefusals(parsed)` walks each `packages[]` entry's flows, or the stack's own flows when it declares no packages (the walk `findExtensionFieldSuffixRefusals` takes), and hands each one to the engine's registration verdict: `FlowSchema.safeParse`, then `validateControlFlow` from `@objectstack/spec/automation`. A refusal is a row `{ path, code: 'VALIDATION_ERROR', flow, message }` whose message is `Flow '<name>' would be refused at registration: ` followed by the engine's message verbatim. Like the engine it stops at a flow's first malformed region; every flow is judged. A flow the schema refuses is left to the schema step.
- **`commands/validate.ts`** step 3a-vi and **`commands/compile.ts`** (`os build`) step 3b-iii-ter call it beside the `__c` reservation gate, ahead of every artifact write, with the same two faces as the gates around them: the command's `--json` failure envelope (`errors` rows), and the text face (`printError` + one bullet per flow, exit 1).

- **`test/validate-build-gate-parity.test.ts`**: `findFlowRegionRefusals` joins `SHARED_NON_REGISTRY_GATES`, the ledger of gates both commands run.

Placement (A), in lane, following #28727: a `cli/src/utils` judge over the spec's exported function. No `packages/spec/**`, `packages/lint/**` or `service-automation` edit.

## Tests

- `test/validate-flow-region-shape.test.ts` (new, in-process `Validate` / `Compile`, 4 cases):
  - the duly shape (`try_catch 'guard'` whose catch region is `d → x, y, z` with no join): validate `--json` exits 1 with a row carrying `try_catch 'guard' catch: region must be single-exit but has 3: x, y, z` and the flow name; build `--json` exits 1, `success: false`, the same row, and no `dist/`;
  - nested (a `loop` whose body is that fan-out, inside a `try_catch` try region): the same, with `try_catch 'outer' try → loop 'sweep' body: …`;
  - single-branch `parallel`: `parallel 'fan': a parallel block needs at least 2 branches`, both commands;
  - control: the joined region (`x, y, z → j`) validates and builds.
  - On `origin/main` (`ff881050`): the three refused cases red (validate exited 0, build succeeded), the control green.
- Ablations, each landed on disk then restored: the call in `validate.ts` replaced by `[]` → 3 red; the call in `compile.ts` replaced by `[]` → 3 red (`expected +0 to be 1`).
- `test/authoring-rule-command-parity.test.ts`: per the seat's ruling, `os lint`'s blindness is recorded as `blindTo: ['lint']`. It sits in a second table, `OUTSIDE_THE_TABLE`, not in `CASES`: every `CASES` row asserts the rule gates on all three commands through `runAuthoringRules`, and this check is not an authoring rule, so a `CASES` row would be red by construction. The new row ASSERTS the blindness (`runAuthoringRules('lint', …)` carries no `single-exit` finding), so closing the gap reds it and the case moves into `CASES`.
- One `os validate` run (real CLI, text face) over the duly fixture:

```
base (ff881050)                              head
  → Running author-time rules (60)...          → Running author-time rules (60)...
  → Checking that every required capability…
  → Checking package docs (ADR-0046)...        ✗ The automation engine would refuse to register 1 flow for a malformed region (ADR-0031)
  ✓ Validation passed (166ms)                  • flows[0] [VALIDATION_ERROR] Flow 'rgn_lead_time' would be refused at registration:
  Logic: 1 Flows                                 try_catch 'guard' catch: region must be single-exit but has 3: x, y, z — add one node
exit 0                                           with an edge from each of x, y, z to it, so it is the region's only exit; …
                                             exit 1
```

## Acceptance notes

- **Clause-② reading.** The order asked for `yes (narrowing)` if the gates read it so. `clause2-line.mjs` reads `yes (narrowing)` as "widens one surface and narrows another"; nothing here widens (no new export, schema key or accepted input; `flow` on the error row is a new member of an existing row list, like `rule` / `packageId` on its neighbours). So the line is `no (narrowing)`, the spelling #28727 used for the same kind of change; the changeset carries the `**BREAKING**` banner and an ADR-0087 `not-required` disposition.
- **Boot side (ruling 3), measured, not changed.** The banner's `Flows:` line (`utils/format.ts` `printAutomationSummary`, ~1718) counts registered flows (`flowCount` = `getFlowRuntimeStates().length`), bound flows and drafts. `declaredFlowCount` (`commands/serve.ts` ~5708, `resolveStackCollection(config, 'flows')`) is read only for the engine-disabled line. A refused flow is in neither count; it surfaces only as its `[Automation] failed to register flow` line in Boot diagnostics. A refused count would be one more `parts.push` beside the draft count, but no one-line, same-file version is exact: `declaredFlowCount - flowCount` is moved by runtime overlay rows and same-named contenders too, and the engine exposes refusals only per name (`getFlowRegistration(name)`), so an exact count needs a new summary field collected in `serve.ts`. Left out, reported. Whether boot continues is untouched.
- **Not closed here, reported**: the lint-rule parity (`os lint` blind, B, domain:devx), and a cycle in the flow's TOP-LEVEL graph, which `os validate` still passes (`start → a → b → a → end`, exit 0): the engine refuses it with `detectCycles` (`packages/services/service-automation/src/flow-registration-checks.ts`), which is exported from that file but not from the package index. Region bodies are cycle-checked, by `validateControlFlow`.
- Seat 3's files (`subflow-guards.ts`, `region-suspension-refusal.ts`, the arming gate) are untouched.

## Verification

Gates: `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` derived 62 commands on the diff; all 62 exit 0, and `--ran` reconciles 62 derived, 62 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED. `pnpm --filter @objectstack/cli typecheck` (runs `check:test-typecheck`): exit 0. `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec check:error-code-provenance`: exit 0. Scoped eslint over the six changed `.ts` files: exit 0.

`pnpm --filter @objectstack/cli exec vitest run --project unit`, after merging `main` (`00d0668d`, nothing under `packages/cli`, `packages/spec` or `packages/lint`): first run 368/369 files, 1 red: `validate-build-gate-parity.test.ts` "every call site … is classified" named `findFlowRegionRefusals`. Fixed by adding it to `SHARED_NON_REGISTRY_GATES` (a gate both commands run); re-run on the final head: 369/369 files, 5201/5201 tests, VERDICT command-exit 0. The `integration` tier (where `authoring-rule-command-parity.test.ts` lives, for its spawn case) is declared to CI; its in-process rule cases, the new pin included, ran locally green (10 passed).

Dogfood battery (owed for the `(narrowing)` arm): after building the `@objectstack/dogfood...` closure (68/68 tasks), `pnpm --filter @objectstack/dogfood test` under the lock, VERDICT command-exit 0 · Test Files 383 passed | 3 skipped (386) · Tests 3163 passed | 28 skipped (3191). It ran on `832bd06d`; the final head adds the ledger row in a `packages/cli` test file and one more merge of `main` (`ab085a04`: under `packages/spec` only `shared/region-currency.*` and a save-notice placement change with a `FlowSchema` comment, nothing the region check reads).
